bio.text: Randy Villegas is the Democratic candidate for California's 22nd Congressional District in 2026.

Villegas graduated from Golden Valley High School and earned an associate degree from Bakersfield College in 2015, a bachelor's degree from California State University, Bakersfield in 2017, and a Ph.D. from the University of California, Santa Cruz in 2022.
According to a Ballotpedia candidate survey, Villegas is a professor at College of the Sequoias and has served on the Visalia School Board.
